card.line: Gomorrah was a city of the plain near Sodom, and God destroyed it with fire for its great sin, so the Bible uses it as a warning.

moments.title: Goods Taken from Gomorrah
moments.text: As the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into tar pits. The four enemy kings took all the goods and food of Sodom and Gomorrah and went on their way.

moments.title: Fire from Heaven
moments.text: The LORD rained sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah. He destroyed the cities, the whole plain, and everyone and everything in them.
